subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` hooks to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but the names, payload shape, enrichment behavior, and channel scope change a public plugin contract and should not be chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
options.body: Add shared observation-only reaction hooks with a typed payload, wire Discord first, and document the expected path for other reaction-capable channels.

options.title: Scope To Discord First
options.body: Accept a Discord-only hook now while requiring explicit follow-up constraints so the public API does not become channel-specific by accident.

options.title: Defer To Broader Event API
options.body: Keep this open behind the broader non-message event SDK discussion before adding reaction-specific hooks.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
recommendation.body: Add shared observation-only reaction hooks with a typed payload, wire Discord first, and document the expected path for other reaction-capable channels.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is public plugin hook API shape, and Vincent is the strongest available routing candidate from the issue discussion and release/history signals.
